keySentence: The treasure was not worth the suffering.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The pirates fought over treasure. Jim's friends shared with each other. Sharing is better than greed. The treasure was not worth the suffering.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The pirates argued louder and louder about the treasure. Silver could barely control his own men anymore. Meanwhile, Jim's side shared food and helped each other. The doctor even treated wounded pirates because it was the right thing. The treasure was not worth the suffering. The difference between greed and generosity became very clear.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: As the conflict continued, the pirates' greed only grew worse and more destructive. They could not agree on anything because each person wanted the largest share. Silver, despite being their leader, found it increasingly difficult to maintain order. In stark contrast, Jim's group worked together and shared their limited resources fairly. The treasure was not worth the suffering. Remarkably, Doctor Livesey even treated injured pirates because he believed in doing what was right. Because Jim's side chose generosity over selfishness, they remained strong and united. This showed that true wealth comes not from gold but from caring for one another.
